# JJK Brawler II — Move List

Every fighter's three specials, their ultimate and their Domain Expansion.

**This file is generated** from `src/characters.js` by
`tools/build_move_list.mjs` — do not edit it by hand, edit the kit and
re-run. Its companions are [characters.md](characters.md), which explains *why*
each kit is the way it is, and [game-mechanics.md](game-mechanics.md), which
explains the systems the moves are built from.

**27 fighters** — every one with three specials and an
ultimate, and **8** of them with a Domain Expansion as well.

An ultimate and a Domain Expansion each cost the **whole** meter bar, so a
fighter who has both is choosing between them every time the bar fills. Specials
are free and run on individual cooldowns instead.

## Every kit in full

<a id="yuji"></a>

### Yuji Itadori — "Sukuna's Vessel"

*Students · `yuji` · theme `#ff8264`*

- Neutral special *(1.2s cooldown)* — **Divergent Fist** — His cursed energy lags a beat behind the fist — one punch, two impacts.
- Side special *(1.3s cooldown)* — **Manji Kick** — A sliding capoeira-style low kick that sweeps in under guards and pokes.
- Down special *(6s cooldown)* — **Unbreakable Grit** — Plants his feet and refuses to fall — for a moment, nothing staggers him.
- Ultimate — **Black Flash: Consecutive** — Cursed energy struck within a millionth of a second of impact — again, and again, and again. Space itself distorts.
- Passive — **Black Flash** — Every melee hit has a 12% chance to spark a Black Flash: bonus damage, extra launch, and a surge of ultimate meter.

<a id="nobara"></a>

### Nobara Kugisaki — "Straw Doll Sorceress"

*Students · `nobara` · theme `#d86a4a`*

- Neutral special *(0.8s cooldown)* — **Straw Doll: Nail Shot** — Cursed nails fired downrange. Every hit hammers a mark deeper into the target.
- Side special *(1.6s cooldown)* — **Hairpin** — Snaps her fingers — every planted nail erupts at once. More marks, more pain.
- Down special *(2.8s cooldown)* — **Resonance** — Drives a nail into the straw doll — marked souls take the hit wherever they stand. Ignores shields.
- Ultimate — **Straw Doll: Deluxe Resonance** — A storm of cursed nails and a full-power resonance ritual. Nowhere to hide from the doll.
- Passive — **Straw Doll Technique** — Nail marks last twice as long, and she can bank up to 6 on one target.

<a id="megumi"></a>

### Megumi Fushiguro — "Ten Shadows"

*Students · `megumi` · theme `#7c8cff`*

- Neutral special *(1.15s cooldown)* — **Great Serpent... no — Nue!** — The shadow bird dives across the arena, crackling with paralytic charge.
- Side special *(7.5s cooldown)* — **Ten Shadows: Shikigami** — He calls whichever shikigami answers — the Divine Dogs, the Great Serpent, the Toad, Max Elephant or a scatter of rabbits — and it fights at his side.
  - *Rolls one per cast:* Divine Dogs · Great Serpent · Toad · Max Elephant · Rabbit Escape
- Down special *(2.4s cooldown)* — **Shadow Sink** — Melts into his own shadow and resurfaces where the fight needs him.
- Ultimate — **Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga** — The complete ritual. The wheel turns, and the general that adapts to everything walks the stage.
- Domain Expansion — **Chimera Shadow Garden** — The floor becomes an ocean of shadow, and everything in it answers to him.
  - *How it plays:* The stage floods with shadow. Press SPECIAL to sink and instantly resurface behind the enemy — unlimited, no cooldown — and every resurface looses a shikigami strike. Shadow also cushions you: knockback taken is halved inside.
- Passive — **Ten Shadows Technique** — Shikigami do the fighting: summon specials build 20% extra ultimate meter.

<a id="yuta"></a>

### Yuta Okkotsu — "Rika's Beloved"

*Students · `yuta` · theme `#9fc7ff`*

- Neutral special *(1s cooldown)* — **Cursed Energy Slash** — A flying arc of raw cursed energy launched off the katana's edge.
- Side special *(1.4s cooldown)* — **Rika's Claw** — Rika reaches through from behind Yuta and rakes everything ahead of him.
- Down special *(5.5s cooldown)* — **Reverse Cursed Technique** — Channel refined cursed energy to knit wounds — interrupted if struck.
- Ultimate — **Full Manifestation: Rika** — The Queen of Curses answers in full. Rika mirrors every blow with her own.
- Domain Expansion — **Authentic Mutual Love** — The vow between them made real — Rika stands with him inside it, whole.
  - *How it plays:* Rika manifests completely and heals you continuously. Press SPECIAL to send her at the enemy for a huge unblockable bite; she can be commanded again after a short beat.
- Passive — **Bond of Love** — Past 100% damage, Rika's fury raises Yuta's damage by 12%.

*Students · `maki` · theme `#69d0a8`*

- Passive — **Heavenly Restriction** — A body beyond curses: immune to burns, snares, and soul marks.

*Students · `inumaki` · theme `#d7d9e7`*

### Kokichi Muta — "Ultimate Mechamaru"

*Students · `mechamaru` · theme `#63c7b0`*

- Neutral special *(1.15s cooldown)* — **Ultra Cannon** — The palm opens and a bolt of purification fire goes down the lane.
- Side special *(1.35s cooldown)* — **Boost On** — Cursed energy vented from the elbows — half a ton of puppet arrives before the sound does.

*Students · `momo` · theme `#b7b8ff`*

### Satoru Gojo — "The Honored One"

*Faculty · `gojo` · theme `#62dcff`*

- Neutral special *(1s cooldown)* — **Cursed Technique Lapse: Blue** — A core of attraction that drags the enemy toward it, then pops.
- Side special *(1.15s cooldown)* — **Cursed Technique Reversal: Red** — A repulsive blast with brutal knockback. Destroys other projectiles.
- Down special *(2.6s cooldown)* — **Infinity** — Stop. The next attack halts at infinity — nullified, and answered.
- Ultimate — **Hollow Technique: Purple** — Blue and Red fused — a hollow mass of imaginary matter erased across the whole stage.
- Domain Expansion — **Unlimited Void** — Infinite information floods the mind. They receive everything and can act on none of it.

- Passive — **Infinity (Passive)** — Neutral stance is wrapped in Infinity: shield loses 45% less health when struck.

*Faculty · `gakuganji` · theme `#d89b3f`*

*Other Sorcerers · `toji` · theme `#a8aeb8`*

- Down special *(9s cooldown)* — **Open the Inventory** — Something pact-bound comes out of storage — the curse that spits cursed tools, the one he lets off the leash, or a husk with a blade still in it.

### Yuki Tsukumo — "Star Rage"

*Other Sorcerers · `yuki` · theme `#ffb703`*

- Neutral special *(1.5s cooldown)* — **Star Rage: Bombaye** — Virtual mass poured into one straight punch. It does not weigh her down — it only lands on whoever is in front of her.
- Side special *(8s cooldown)* — **Garuda** — Her shikigami — a winged serpent she loads with the same virtual mass she loads herself with. It fights on its own.
- Down special *(4.5s cooldown)* — **New Shadow Style: Simple Domain** — The circle she taught Todo. It turns what reaches it, and a domain's guaranteed hit stops being guaranteed.

### Kinji Hakari — "The Gambler"

*Other Sorcerers · `hakari` · theme `#ff62cf`*

- Neutral special *(1.25s cooldown)* — **Rough Energy Shutter** — Slams a cursed-energy shutter door forward that bulldozes the lane.
- Side special *(1.35s cooldown)* — **Restless Rush** — A reckless advancing flurry — Hakari's favorite way to say hello.
- Down special *(3.2s cooldown)* — **Reserve Balance** — Spin the pachinko reels: heal, meter, a power surge... or a dud. Feeling lucky?
- Ultimate — **JACKPOT** — He skips the reels and simply collects: 4:11 of infinite cursed energy. Wounds erase themselves and nothing staggers him.

<a id="mahito"></a>

### Mahito — "Soul Shaper"

*Curses and Curse Users · `mahito` · theme `#b56cff`*

- Neutral special *(2.1s cooldown)* — **Idle Transfiguration** — One touch on the soul and the body follows. Cannot be blocked — only avoided.
- Side special *(1.3s cooldown)* — **Body Distortion Lunge** — His arm warps into a blade mid-stride and carves through the approach.
- Down special *(3.4s cooldown)* — **Transfigured Souls** — Reshapes a stored soul into whatever amuses him — a lurching bomb, a bloated hulk, a pair of crawlers, or something that sits back and spits.
  - *Rolls one per cast:* Transfigured Human · Bloated Hulk · Crawlers · Spitter
- Ultimate — **Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing** — His true form — a streamlined killing body. Faster, crueler, and nothing blocks it.
- Domain Expansion — **Self-Embodiment of Perfection** — Every surface is his hand. Inside, a soul is something he simply reaches out and reshapes.
  - *How it plays:* Every attack you land is a direct soul touch: nothing can be blocked, and each hit stacks Distortion on them. At five stacks the soul collapses on its own for massive damage and the counter resets — so keep touching them.
- Passive — **Idle Transfiguration (Passive)** — Every hit brushes the soul: marked victims take 18% more damage from all sources.

*Curses and Curse Users · `jogo` · theme `#ff7a2f`*

*Curses and Curse Users · `hanami` · theme `#9bb36b`*

<a id="dagon"></a>

### Dagon — "Disaster of Tides"

*Curses and Curse Users · `dagon` · theme `#2f8fd8`*

- Neutral special *(1.3s cooldown)* — **Disaster Tides** — Water from nothing: a wall of it rolls out along the floor and takes everything with it.
- Side special *(4s cooldown)* — **Man-Eating Shikigami** — Eels, piranha and small sharks conjured straight out of his body — they swim at whoever is closest and burst on them.
- Down special *(2.4s cooldown)* — **Undertow** — He draws the water back in, and everything swimming in it comes with it. No launch — it just puts them where he wants them, soaked.
- Ultimate — **Death Swarm** — Shikigami without end, thrown at one target until there is nothing left to throw them at.
- Domain Expansion — **Horizon of the Captivating Skandha** — A sunny shore, palms on one side and an ocean that does not end on the other. Inside it his shikigami do not travel to you — they are already there.
  - *How it plays:* Fish bite automatically and cannot be dodged or blocked, and every bite leaves the enemy soaked. Press SPECIAL for Death Swarm: an unblockable surge on the enemy, on a short cooldown. Note a Simple Domain shuts the automatic bites off.
- Passive — **Disaster of Water** — Born from the fear of drowning: soaked opponents take 15% more damage from him, and nothing he makes can soak him.

*Curses and Curse Users · `kurourushi` · theme `#8f3b4e`*

- Neutral special *(1s cooldown)* — **Festering Life Sword: Egg Volley** — Six barrels along the blade's spine. The eggs hatch the instant they find a wound.
- Side special *(6.5s cooldown)* — **Cursed Cockroaches** — Real roaches, reinforced with cursed energy. One is nothing. The swarm strips a body in seconds.
- Down special *(2.4s cooldown)* — **Earthen Insect Trance** — Flying curses carrying sacs of liquid. They burst across the eyes, and after that the fight is a guess.

### Suguru Geto — "Curse Collector"

*Curses and Curse Users · `geto` · theme `#7d58d8`*

- Neutral special *(1.2s cooldown)* — **Cursed Spirit Volley** — Releases a handful of lesser curses that drift hungrily toward the enemy.
- Side special *(8s cooldown)* — **Cursed Spirit Release** — He opens the collection: the Rainbow Dragon, a Smallpox Deity, a brace of curse hounds or a cursed womb — whatever his hand finds.
  - *Rolls one per cast:* Rainbow Dragon · Smallpox Deity · Curse Hounds · Cursed Womb
- Down special *(2.3s cooldown)* — **Kuchisake-Onna's Scissors** — Plants a lurking curse ahead; it erupts in shears when the enemy steps close.
- Ultimate — **Maximum: Uzumaki** — Every stockpiled curse extracted and wrung into a single spiraling annihilation.
- Passive — **Cursed Spirit Manipulation** — Feeds on the fight: summon specials return double ultimate meter.

### Choso — "Eldest Brother"

*Curses and Curse Users · `choso` · theme `#c22e4a`*

- Neutral special *(1.15s cooldown)* — **Piercing Blood** — Blood pressurized past the speed of sound — a needle-thin lance across the whole lane. It costs him a little of himself.
- Side special *(1.6s cooldown)* — **Convergence: Blood Meteorite** — Hardened blood compressed into a dense sphere that detonates on arrival.
- Down special *(6.5s cooldown)* — **Flowing Red Scale** — Overclocks his own blood — pulse, temperature, clotting, all past human limits. Holding it burns him slowly.
- Ultimate — **Supernova** — Orbs of compressed blood ring the enemy in silence — then every one of them detonates inward at once.
- Passive — **Death Painting Body** — Half curse, half human, all blood: immune to bleed and poison. His blood techniques spend health instead of restraint.

### Ryomen Sukuna — "King of Curses"

*Curses and Curse Users · `sukuna` · theme `#ff4c55`*

- Neutral special *(0.85s cooldown)* — **Dismantle** — The default slash of the King of Curses, thrown as easily as breathing.
- Side special *(1.25s cooldown)* — **Cleave** — Adjusts to the target's toughness and carves straight through the space they hold.
- Down special *(2.3s cooldown)* — **Divine Flame: Fuga** — “Open.” An arrow of divine fire that detonates on arrival.
- Ultimate — **Dismantle: Merciless Barrage** — A carving rush too fast to read — Dismantle after Dismantle, closed with a Cleave that finds the exact toughness of whatever it meets.
- Domain Expansion — **Malevolent Shrine** — The shrine of skulls, raised without walls. Everything inside its reach is already cut.
  - *How it plays:* A ring of cleave-blades orbits the shrine and slashes rain on the enemy automatically. Press SPECIAL to snatch a blade out of the air, then LIGHT or HEAVY to unleash it as a colossal Cleave — the more blades still orbiting when you throw, the harder it lands.
- Passive — **King's Contempt** — Scents weakness: +10% damage against opponents past 80%.
